steps.text: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village. CKR fairy ring or take cart from Brimhaven.
choices: Is there anything else interesting to do around here?
Yes.

steps.text: Talk to a Jungle Forester south of Shilo Village.
choices: I need to talk to you about red mahogany.
Okay, I'll take your axe to get it sharpened.

steps.text: Talk to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop.
choices: Do you sharpen axes?
Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.

steps.text: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village.
choices: Could I ask you about being a character witness?
Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?
Oh, okay, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.

steps.text: Enter the H.A.M hideout west of Lumbridge and talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in there.
Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht in the south of the H.A.M hideout.
choices: I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.
And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?
Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!

steps.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
choices: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.

steps.text: Talk to Seth Groats in the farm north east of Lumbridge, across the river.
choices: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!

steps.text: Talk to Horvik in the armour shop north east of the Varrock square.
choices: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages!
Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

steps.text: Talk to the Apothecary in west Varrock.
choices: Talk about One Small Favour.
Oh, ok, I guess it's not that far to the Barbarian Village.
I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

steps.text: Talk to Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village pottery building.
choices: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

steps.text: Go into the Dwarven Mine and talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west side.
Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west cavern of the Dwarven Mine.
choices: Have you always been a gangster?
Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

steps.text: Talk to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
Talk to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
choices: Are you taking any new initiates?
A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.
Yep, it's a deal.

steps.text: Use a bowl of hot water on an empty cup.
Use 2 guams, a marrentill and a harralander on the cup.

choices: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

steps.text: Right-click talk to Captain Bleemadge on White Wolf Mountain.
choices: How was that tea?
Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

steps.text: Talk to Arhein in Catherby.

steps.text: Talk to Phantuwti in the south west house of Seers' Village.
choices: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?
What can I do to help?
Yes, Ok, I'll do it.

steps.text: Enter the cave south east of the Fishing Guild.
Right-click search the sculpture in the wall in the north east corner of the cave.
Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
choices: Chat.
I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!
Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!

Okay, I'll do it!

Ok, I'll see what I can do.
